summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing a press release and earnings presentation for Q2 2026. The filing reports consolidated revenue of NT$1,270.38 billion, net income of NT$706.56 billion, and diluted EPS of NT$27.25 (US$4.31 per ADR unit). Results show significant year-over-year increases and provide guidance for Q3 2026. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic changes; this is a routine earnings report on Form 6-K.
